study: Study 1: best pad coverage per architecture, pad thickness and required flexion (2D side model, finger length 90 mm)

report/study1/data/raw/coverage.csv.rows: one per (architecture, required flexion, pad thickness): the best design found

definitions.c_pad: pad coverage C̄_pad (fraction 0-1) of the best design over the search runs
definitions.c_pad_worst_run: the worst of the runs (GA and NSGA-II, three seeds each)
definitions.idealized: upper bound without the joint actuator (CFL ideal, RCJ ideal)
definitions.design_found: false where no design meets the requirement
definitions.ma_wc: worst-case mechanical advantage of the transmission
definitions.stop_reason: the constraint that ended the search's improvement
